opportunities.fit_notes: CORRECTED ASSESSMENT (2026-04-24): Two hooks missed on first read. (1) CAUSE WE CARE (CWC), DDI's affiliated 501(c)(3), holds CSH Supportive Housing Onboarding and CSH Building Community in Supportive Housing certifications (Dec 2023); CWC's focus areas include homelessness/coordinated entry and community health for underserved populations — this aligns directly with the RFQ's CBO framing, OUD recovery housing, and opioid settlement scope. (2) Category 1 includes transportation support (bus passes, work transportation, transportation referrals) and the OSF Approved Uses explicitly include transportation to treatment — DDI's NEMT/DOT credentials could underpin that sub-element in CWC's service plan. Real barrier: DDI and CWC are Michigan-based; Contra Costa County gives explicit preference to organizations with principal place of business in CCC for ≥6 months. If no CA delivery partner, prime pursuit is at a disadvantage. Most viable path: CWC as applicant (not DDI) with a California-based recovery residence or employment org as a delivery sub/partner. Questions deadline was April 17 (passed). SOQ deadline April 27 (3 days).
